chief_complaint: watery diarrhea and stomach cramps for two days
hpi_details: started yesterday morning with loose stools, now watery diarrhea 4-5 times a day. Mild abdominal cramping before going to the toilet. No fever, no blood in stool, no vomiting. Feeling weak and slightly thirsty. Ate at a new street food market two nights ago.
ideas: thinks he might have gotten food poisoning from the street food market
concerns: worried he will get dehydrated and wants to know if he needs antibiotics
expectations: wants to know how to stop the diarrhea and if he should stay home from work
social_hx: office worker, lives with room-mate, non-smoker

learning_objectives: Practise asking about stool frequency, consistency, and accompanying symptoms (fever, blood, pain)
Use plain language to explain self-care (hydration, oral rehydration solutions, diet)
Address concerns about antibiotics and clarify that uncomplicated acute diarrhea is often self-limiting and antibiotics are not routinely needed
Practise showing empathy for the patient's discomfort
suggested_questions: Can you tell me more about what you've been experiencing?
How many times a day have you had to go to the toilet?
Is there any blood or mucus in the stool?
Have you had any fever or vomiting?
What have you eaten recently that might have caused this?
I understand this is uncomfortable. Are you able to drink fluids?

objective_cues.say: Many cases settle on their own, so antibiotics are not routinely needed; the important thing is preventing dehydration.
